89590: Vanitas is an average human being who inherited his name and the Book of Vanitas from the infamous vampire. He seems to often take nothing seriously and almost always has a broad grin on his face.
89835: Noé is a gentleman vampire. His story began when he received a letter from The Teacher, which explained that The Teacher wanted Noé to fly to Paris immediately, as there had been rumors that The Book of Vanitas had been found there.
89836: A vampire who acts as the Chevalier to Luca. Jeanne is fiercely protective of Luca and gives off an air of rigidity and power while conducting her duty as his chevalier; however, she is prone to frantic outbursts, especially when in the presence of Vanitas, whom she dislikes.
139553: Noé's childhood friend and the sister of Louis and Veronica. Her father is Count de Sade and her grandfather is Noé's teacher. She is a flirtatious, playful, energetic, and charming young lady.
139554: He is a human and known as the Sixth Paladin, and honored with the green gem of Jasper for his service as a Chasseur.
145998: He is a human who at the age of fifteen became the youngest Paladin in the history of the Chasseurs, and having been subject to the bias that all Vampires are inherently evil, has dedicated his life toward their eradication in the name of his faith.
146014: She is a vampire that resides in the castle of Marquis d'Apchier, where her existence is hidden and is known there as the "Hidden Vampire" of the Marquis' family.
146015: Noé's cat. Murr never shows any other emotion apart from irritability but seems to care a great deal for Noé - often times lurking in the shadows and watching Noé.
146017: He is a Vampire of the Crimson Moon. Louis had been born into the De Sade aristocracy alongside the likes of Veronica and Dominique de Sade, however because of certain circumstances Count de Sade sent him to live with his grandfather permanently.
153506: He is a Vampire of noble birth born to inherit the title of Grand Duke, Luca is close to The Queen, though he is still too young to accept the role himself, thus allowing his uncle, Lord Ruthven, to act on his behalf.
155248: Naenia is a mysterious ethereal entity from Jun Mochizuki's The Case Study of Vanitas. As a member of Charlatan, Naenia works alongside her colleagues, invading the subconscious of Vampires in order to inflict them with a Malnomen by distorting their true names.
155325: Olivier is high-strung due to the constant agitation he has from Roland's impropriety as a chasseur. He is quick to anger towards Roland and is constantly frustrated at his inability to temper Roland's wilfulness.
155326: Lord Ruthven is a Vampire Lord who serves the Queen as a member of the senate. Due to his position, Lord Ruthven has had prominence since the war between humanity and Vampires.
155327: Riche is a Dhampir who acts as an Information Broker. Often partnered with fellow Dhampirs, Dante and Johann, Riche commonly works on cases in relation to Curse-Bearing Vampires.
155328: Dante is a Dhampir acting as an insurance broker and jack-of-all-trades, he often partners with Vanitas, selling him information or working alongside him in pursuit of Curse-Bearing Vampires.
155329: Johann is a Dhampir who acts as an information broker and associate of Dante and Riche's. Johann typically displays a flamboyant personality, characterized by his often animated facial expressions and a teasing and flirtatious manner of speech.
155330: Jean-Jacques Chastel is a vampire who is shown to be a servant of Chloe d'Apchier in D'Apchier Family Castle at Silver Forest, Gévaudan.
181061: Misha has a cheerful smile and seems to be quite friendly and perceptive, but he also appears to be a bit dangerous.
230438: The Master belongs to the de Sade aristocracy - being the grandfather of Dominique de Sade - and is widely feared by many.
236204: Vanitas of the Blue Moon is a vampire. According to legend, they were born under the Blue Moon and were the ostensible creator of the Book of Vanitas and the disease Malnomen.
236210: Amelia Ruth is a woman Noé meets during a trip to Paris aboard La Baleine.
242839: Parks Orlok is the appointed representative of the Vampires by The Queen following the war between humans and Vampires; tasked with maintaining a balance between the human and Vampire worlds by watching over Vampire-related activities.
242840: Nox is a vampire who works alongside her brother, Manet, under Count Parks Orlok as his personal security.
242842: Manet is a vampire who works alongside his sister, Nox, under Count Parks Orlok as his personal security.
242844: Targeted by Charlatan, Berneux's true name, Bucolicus, fell prey to Malnomen Loup Garou - causing him to mutate and lash out - killing nine humans in cyclical bouts of uncontrollable thirst; becoming the most publicized occurrence of violence against humans since the war.
242847: A Vampire of the Crimson Moon with a keen interest in automation, as well as the head of the the Machina Marquisate. As a member of the senate, Machina is often involved in the higher affairs of Vampires.
242848: A Vampire of the Crimson Moon, the second eldest child of Count de Sade and older sister of Dominique de Sade. She acts as a Beastia - or an enforcer to Queen Faustina - a result of her ability to alter World Formulae to produce ice.
242849: A young girl from a noble Vampire of the Crimson Moon family.
246645: Maria is a human character from Jun Mochizuki's The Case Study of Vanitas. As a Chasseur, Maria has been subjected to the bias that Vampires as a whole are evil, and has thus dedicated her life to eradicating them in the name of her faith.
249441: Gilles is a Vampire of the Crimson Moon and childhood friend of Noé Archiviste and Louis and Dominique de Sade.
249442: Mina is a Vampire of the Crimson Moon from Jun Mochizuki's The Case Study of Vanitas. Mina is a child from a neighboring town to the De Sade estate who became close friends with Noé Archiviste and Louis and Dominique de Sade.
249443: Fred is a Vampire of the Crimson Moon and childhood friend of Noé Archiviste and Louis and Dominique de Sade.
249444: Fanny is a Vampire of the Crimson Moon and a childhood friend of Noé Archiviste and Louis and Dominique de Sade.
250994: Doctor Moreau is a human from Jun Mochizuki's The Case Study of Vanitas. A mad scientist previously employed by the Chasseurs in order to research on Vampires - Moreau became obsessed with the concept of becoming a Vampire himself, resulting in his exile from the Chasseurs.
256488: Alongside Naenia and the Plague Doctor, Monsieur Spider infiltrated Marquis Machina's bal masqué in an attempt to assassinate Luca as Grand Duke Oriflamme while the guests were distracted with the four Curse-Bearers Naenia had afflicted with the Malnomen Dissonance.
266525: Loki is the elder sibling of Luca Oriflamme and serves the Queen as a powerful Beastia; however, he is also a known Curse-Bearer.
